pages.text: Aurora Forge operates a solar microgrid at its coastal workshop. The rooftop array produces 42 megawatt-hours of electricity each year. Solar generation powers the workshop during daylight hours.

The workshop collects rainwater from its roof in two 5,000-liter cisterns. Filtered rainwater is used for cleaning tools and watering the native garden. Drinking water comes from the municipal supply.
Aurora Forge stores excess electricity in a 120-kilowatt-hour lithium iron phosphate battery. A temperature sensor disconnects the battery if its enclosure exceeds 45 degrees Celsius.
Northstar Clinic schedules new-patient appointments by phone or through its patient portal. Patients should bring photo identification and a list of current medications to their first visit.
Northstar Clinic opens at 8:30 a.m. Monday through Friday and closes at 5:00 p.m. The clinic is closed on weekends and public holidays.
